preconditions.description: The number of acorns n is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.
The length of the Euler tour list a is exactly 2n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= n for x in a)
preconditions.description: Each element in the Euler tour list a is between 0 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value[0] == 'no' or (return_value[0] == 'yes' and len(return_value[1]) == 2 * n - 1 and all(1 <= x <= n for x in return_value[1]))
postconditions.description: The output is either 'no' or a valid Euler tour of length 2n - 1 with each element between 1 and n inclusive.
If the output is a valid Euler tour, the first and last elements are the same.

postconditions.expression: return_value[0] == 'no' or all(abs(return_value[1][i] - return_value[1][i+1]) == 1 for i in range(len(return_value[1]) - 1))
postconditions.description: If the output is a valid Euler tour, each pair of consecutive elements differs by exactly 1.
